notes.title: IMPORTANT NEWS 2021-04 - NEW RELEASE
notes.notes:
Hi my friends,

After many works and thinking, I’ve decided I will release a new concept of the game. You know I’m alone and I make it in part-time job, so I had to make a big decision. I saw you just wait and wait the update, but I haven’t had enough time to finish the new chapter(currently it’s 70%), because I have to work in my full time job (I have to eat:))). 
So I figured out a new concept, it focuses on sexual scenes and I can always give you update in 2-3 weeks. Soon I will release it on Steam and on my Patreon(more content), too.  

I hope you are glad and curious.

Bests,
Steve
